relations.myth: Teodosio de Goñi and Saint Michael at Aralar
relations.note: Michael kills or decapitates Herensuge after it threatens the chained Teodosio.

relations.myth: Teodosio de Goñi and Saint Michael at Aralar
relations.note: Some retellings say Michael confronts Herensuge only with God or divine authority.

relations.myth: Teodosio de Goñi and Saint Michael at Aralar
relations.note: The Devil deceives Teodosio before the infernal dragon episode but is not explicitly Herensuge.

relations.myth: The Grateful Tartaro and the Heren-Suge
relations.note: Tartaro helps equip the hero who later kills Herensuge; they never interact directly.
relations.source: Webster, The Grateful Tartaro and the Heren-Suge

relations.note: Folklorists proposed equation or motif-transfer between the two serpentine beings.
